title: Hand Crosshair
description: Turns your crosshair into a hand!
body:
# Hand Crosshair

Wanted a different crosshair in Minecraft? You've come to the right place! This pack replaces the default crosshair with a pointing hand!

This pack is not compatible with hany other crosshair packs.

IMPORTANT: You will not need to download new versions of this pack when Minecraft gets updated; any version of this pack works with any version of Minecraft (Ignore the 'Broken' or 'made for older' or 'made for newer' messages)
